question.text:
Consider the following pairs of compounds 



Of these pairs

options.text: both X and Y are resonance forms
both X and Y are tautomeric forms
X is a resonance pair, while Y is a pair of tautomers
X is a pair of tautomers; while Y is a resonance pair

solution.text:
In 'X' pair of compounds, delocalization of electrons occurs without the change in the relative position of bonded atoms (or nuclei). Hence, X is a resonance pair.

In Y pair of compounds, shifting of proton H+ occurs from N atom to O atom. Hence, 'Y' is a pair of tautomers.
